_note: Sample summary of weekly-release-sync.vtt, written to show the e-mail layout. It is not output from a model run.
overview: The team reviewed the 2.4 release, a crash on older Android phones, user testing of the new onboarding screens and a Q&A session for the support team. The crash fix is merged, but two Android 9 models still crash and the regression run is only half done, so the release moves from Thursday to next Tuesday. Onboarding version B tested best and is planned for 2.5.
key_points: The crash came from the sync queue being read before the database had finished opening. The fix is merged.
Two older Android 9 models still crash, probably for a different reason. Together they are well under one percent of active users.
About half of the regression run is done. The payments flow and the settings screens are still to be tested.
Seven of eight testers finished onboarding version B without help, against four for version A. Version C confused people at the permissions step.
Version B changes the sign-up code, so it is too late for 2.4.
Support wants to know what changed in 2.4 and what to tell customers about the crash.
The staging server certificate expires at the end of the month.
decisions: Release 2.4 moves from Thursday to next Tuesday so the full regression run can finish.
Onboarding version B will ship in 2.5, not 2.4.
The Q&A session with support will be on Thursday morning.
The platform team will be asked to renew the staging certificate.

action_items.task: Send Tom the logs from the two Android 9 phones that still crash
